explanation.expected_timing_gain: Estimated critical path delay reduction from 2.78 ns to approximately 1.7–1.9 ns (35–45% faster) in the same standard cell mapping, because the number of serial adder levels drops from 7 to 3.
explanation.bottleneck: The original design sums eight partial products using a serial chain of seven 16-bit adders (sum[i] = sum[i-1] + partial_product_i), creating a critical path through seven carry-propagate additions.
explanation.functional_boundaries: All 65,536 possible unsigned 8-bit input combinations produce the identical 16-bit product as the baseline; no overflow occurs in intermediate sums because the final product fits in 16 bits and all partial sums are nonnegative.
explanation.rewrite: Rebalanced the accumulation as a binary tree of the same eight partial products, reducing the adder depth from seven to three while using the same number of adders.
explanation.area_or_other_cost: Area remains approximately equal: same number of AND gates (64) and 16-bit adders (7) as baseline; only the adder topology changes. Minor routing increase possible due to parallel tree wires.

source_provenance.cell_to_rtl_line_mapping: not established; src coverage alone is not a verified mapping

rtl_source_cone.precision: BIT_LEVEL_CONSERVATIVE; unknown cell types are omitted, and add/sub carry dependencies are conservatively expanded to all lower operand bits.
